detail.readme_excerpt:
# Awesome Opus 5.5 Videos Viral videos people made with **Claude Opus 5.5**, each with the prompt the creator shared (or, where no prompt was published, their original post). Every video here was made by asking Claude Opus 5.5 to write the animation as code (HTML, Canvas, SVG, Three.js and friends). Pick one, copy its prompt, and try it with your own agent. **[▶ Watch all 418 side by side with live remakes on Skillry](https://skillry.dev/ai-videos/opus-5-5?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=awesome-opus5-5-videos)** - 703 prompts in [`prompts/`](prompts/) and [`data/videos.json`](data/videos.json), 418 of them with a live remake on Skillry - 100 remade videos highlighted below, one per distinct prompt - Every entry links to the creator's original post - Latest update (2026-10-12): 10 videos added, mostly explainers and 3d scenes - 2026-10-12: 285 more prompts added (see [Latest prompts](#latest-prompts)) ## Contents - [Motion graphics](#motion-graphics) (58) - [Explainers](#explainers) (16) - [3D scenes](#3d-scenes) (14) - [Games & interactive](#games--interactive) (12) - [Latest prompts](#latest-prompts) (30) - [How to use a prompt](#how-to-use-a-prompt) - [Credits](#credits) ## Motion graphics
